# Neptune Logistics

> Licensed Freight Forwarder and Customs House Agent (CHA) in Sri Lanka. 100% in-house sea freight, air freight, customs clearance, warehousing, and road transport.

## Main Navigation
- [Home](https://neptunelogistics.lk/) - Homepage showing overview of core services, family heritage, and statistics.
- [About Us](https://neptunelogistics.lk/about.html) - History, mission, and family heritage of Neptune Logistics.
- [Careers](https://neptunelogistics.lk/careers.html) - Open vacancies and how to apply.
- [FAQ](https://neptunelogistics.lk/faq.html) - Frequently asked questions about freight forwarding and customs clearance.
- [Contact Us](https://neptunelogistics.lk/contact.html) - Head office and city office addresses, telephone, email, and quote request form.

## Services
- [Ocean Cargo Forwarding](https://neptunelogistics.lk/ocean-cargo.html) - FCL & LCL ocean cargo, direct carrier relations, and in-house port teams.
- [Air Cargo Forwarding](https://neptunelogistics.lk/air-cargo.html) - Fast air cargo forwarding, perishables handling, and dedicated air charters.
- [Container Cargo](https://neptunelogistics.lk/container-cargo.html) - Equipment specifications and intermodal container drayage.
- [Rail Transport](https://neptunelogistics.lk/rail-transport.html) - Heavy haul and inland block train coordination.
- [Last Mile Delivery](https://neptunelogistics.lk/last-mile-delivery.html) - Islandwide dispatch and doorstep fulfillment.
- [Customs Clearance](https://neptunelogistics.lk/services/customs-clearance.html) - Government-licensed same-day customs clearance.
- [Warehousing](https://neptunelogistics.lk/services/warehousing.html) - Short/long term secure storage, packing, and container consolidation.
- [Port Handling](https://neptunelogistics.lk/services/port-handling.html) - Direct port coordination and container movement at Colombo port.

## Industries Served
- [Automotive & Manufacturing](https://neptunelogistics.lk/industries/automotive.html) - JIT parts delivery and supply chain management for the automotive sector.
- [Aviation & Aerospace](https://neptunelogistics.lk/industries/aviation-aerospace.html) - Critical aerospace parts shipment and AOG (Aircraft on Ground) support.
- [Pharmaceutical & Healthcare](https://neptunelogistics.lk/industries/pharmaceutical.html) - Validated cold chain, temperature-controlled shipping for pharmaceuticals.
- [Aid & Relief](https://neptunelogistics.lk/industries/aid-relief.html) - Specialized, urgent logistics solutions for aid, relief, and humanitarian cargo.
